applicable_domain: existing software repositories with a clear feature, bug, refactor, review, performance, build, or test objective
technical decisions, migrations, dependency changes, and implementation verification
negative_examples: discover what product to build when the user problem and success criteria are still vague
make a disposable demo only to validate an idea
write product acceptance scenarios without implementing or testing code
triage pull requests or operate GitHub as a repository maintainer
prerequisites: a workspace or repository is available when code changes are requested
the desired behavior or engineering question is specific enough to inspect
